title: The office and doing business
intro: Working vocabulary for meetings, deadlines and paperwork. See unit 17 for jobs and unit 37 for officialdom.

entries.note: el plan is a plan in general — see unit 42.
el reporte is also used in Latin America.

ex.en: I handed in the report on Friday.

entries.note: a corto plazo is short-term; a largo plazo long-term; pagar a plazos to pay in instalments.

ex.en: We paid for it in twelve instalments.

entries.note: la junta is the usual word for a meeting in Mexico, and also a governing board.

ex.es: La junta es a las diez.

ex.en: He applied for the manager's post.

ex.es: Compré fruta en un puesto del mercado.
ex.en: I bought fruit at a market stall.

entries.note: el jefe is the boss — see unit 17. el director the director or head.

ex.es: Habla con el gerente, por favor.

entries.note: en venta means for sale. See unit 18 for the verbs.

ex.es: Las ventas subieron un diez por ciento.
ex.en: Sales rose by ten per cent.

entries.note: firmar un contrato is to sign a contract — see unit 37.

ex.en: The contract runs for a year.

entries.note: el recibo is a receipt; la cuenta the bill in a restaurant — see unit 12.

ex.en: Send me the invoice by email.
I asked for three different quotes.

entries.note: From ganar and perder — see unit 17 and unit 28.

ex.es: Las ganancias del año fueron buenas.

ex.en: They closed because of the losses.

ex.es: Hay varios negocios en esa calle.
ex.en: There are several shops on that street.

ex.es: Es mi socio desde hace diez años.
ex.en: He's been my business partner for ten years.

ex.es: Sólo entran los socios del club.

entries.en: to take charge of, to see to
entries.note: el encargado is the person in charge. Yo me encargo means leave it to me.

ex.es: Yo me encargo de las bebidas.
ex.en: I'll take care of the drinks.

entries.note: From pedir — see unit 2. hacer un pedido is to place an order.
sacar copias is to make photocopies.

ex.en: I need a copy of the contract.

ex.es: Traiga el original y una copia.
ex.en: Bring the original and a copy.

entries.note: los datos are data, and also personal details on a form.
subir and bajar do the same job in speech — see unit 22.

ex.es: El consumo disminuyó a la mitad.

entries.warn: el éxito is not an exit. The exit is la salida. tener éxito is to be successful.
